'''Jagannath points''' were a concept of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] religion. Jagannath points were earned by hunters for each kill, and when they died, the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] would tally the points to determine the hunter's place in the afterlife. To be captured alive was the greatest of humiliations, and reset a Trandoshan's lifetime score back to nothing, invalidating a lifetime's work unless they killed the person responsible. If a hunter died without ever having earned a single Jagannath Point in their lifetime; excluding Hunters that had lost Points by being captured, than the Scorekeeper would be said to humiliate the failed hunter by reincarnating them into Prey instead.
